sources.summary: Are you making cutbacks in light of the price increases? The average price of diesel in the UK climbed to a record £2 a litre on 2 October . The price of a litre at UK forecourts has risen 40.5% since late February, when the US-Israel war on Iran began disrupting supplies of crude and refined oil products from the Gulf, leading to cost increases across the economy.
